The '''2026–27 season''' is [[Liverpool F.C.|Liverpool Football Club]]'s 135th overall and their 65th consecutive season in the top flight of [[Football in England|English football]]. In addition to the [[2026–27 Premier League|Premier League]], the club is also participating in the [[2026–27 FA Cup|FA Cup]], the [[2026–27 EFL Cup|EFL Cup]], and the [[2026–27 UEFA Champions League|UEFA Champions League]].

A major change in ownership structure was announced on 14 August 2026, when [[Fenway Sports Group]] agreed to sell a 38% stake to 1892 Holdings, a consortium led and managed by [[Amit Bhatia]]. The consortium also includes [[Jeff Bezos]], who will not take a seat in the board and is represented by managing partner Bryan Baum, [[Facebook]] co-founder [[Eduardo Saverin]] and the [[Lakshmi Mittal|Mittal family]].<ref>{{cite news |title=FSG announces strategic minority investment in Liverpool FC |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/fsg-announces-strategic-minority-investment-liverpool-fc |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |date=14 August 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Jeff Bezos consortium owns close to 40% of Liverpool |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7521009/2026/08/18/liverpool-sale-stake-jeff-bezos-takeover/ |publisher=The New York Times |date=18 August 2026}}</ref>

==Coaching staff==
{{updated|25 October 2026}}<ref name="FirstTeam">{{cite web |title=Men's Team - Squad Listing |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/teams/mens-team |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |access-date=1 July 2026}}</ref>

This season is the first under new head coach [[Andoni Iraola]], who was appointed on a two-year contract on 4 June 2026,<ref>{{cite news |title=Liverpool FC appoint Andoni Iraola as new head coach |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/liverpool-fc-appoint-andoni-iraola-new-head-coach |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |date=4 June 2026}}</ref> succeeding [[Arne Slot]] after he departed on 30 May 2026.<ref>{{cite news |title=Liverpool FC statement |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/liverpool-fc-statement-13 |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |date=30 May 2026}}</ref>

This season is the first since [[2016–17 Liverpool F.C. season|2016–17]] without [[Mohamed Salah]] and [[Andy Robertson]], and the first since [[2020–21 Liverpool F.C. season|2020–21]] without [[Ibrahima Konaté]], all of whom departed the club upon the expiry of their respective contracts. It is also the first season since 2016–17 without [[Curtis Jones (footballer, born 2001)|Curtis Jones]], who departed to Italian side [[Inter Milan]].

==Pre-season and friendlies==
On 4 March 2026, Liverpool announced a pre-season tour in the [[United States]] visiting [[Nashville, Tennessee|Nashville]], [[New York City]] and [[Chicago]], playing against [[Sunderland A.F.C.|Sunderland]], [[Wrexham A.F.C.|Wrexham]] and [[Leeds United F.C.|Leeds United]] respectively.<ref>{{cite news |title=Liverpool to face Sunderland, Wrexham and Leeds on 2026 pre-season tour |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/liverpool-face-sunderland-wrexham-and-leeds-2026-pre-season-tour |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |date=4 March 2026}}</ref> On 2 June 2026, two further friendlies against [[AS Monaco FC|Monaco]] and [[Como 1907|Como]] were announced, to conclude Liverpool's pre-season programme.<ref>{{cite news |title=Liverpool to face AS Monaco and Como 1907 in pre-season fixtures at Anfield |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/liverpool-face-monaco-and-como-1907-pre-season-fixtures-anfield |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |date=2 June 2026}}</ref> An extra [[Behind closed doors (sport)|behind-closed-doors]] friendly against Como was later confirmed on 22 July 2026.<ref>{{cite news |title=Liverpool to play extra friendly with Como 1907 behind closed doors |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/liverpool-play-extra-friendly-como-1907-behind-closed-doors |date=22 July 2026 |publisher=Liverpool F.C.}}</ref>

===EFL Cup===
{{main|2026–27 EFL Cup}}

As one of the Premier League clubs participating in European competitions, Liverpool entered the EFL Cup in the third round, and were drawn at home against Premier League side [[Tottenham Hotspur F.C.|Tottenham Hotspur]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Carabao Cup Round Three Draw: Anfield set to host Liverpool vs Tottenham |url=https://www.efl.com/news/2026/august/26/carabao-cup-round-three-draw--anfield-set-to-host-liverpool-vs-tottenham |publisher=English Football League |date=26 August 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Liverpool to host Tottenham Hotspur in Carabao Cup third round |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/liverpool-host-tottenham-hotspur-carabao-cup-third-round |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |date=26 August 2026}}</ref> In the fourth round, they were drawn at home to Premier League [[Chelsea F.C.–Liverpool F.C. rivalry|rivals]] [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Carabao Cup Round Four draw in full |url=https://www.efl.com/news/2026/september/16/carabao-cup-round-four-draw-in-full |publisher=English Football League |date=16 September 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Liverpool to face Chelsea in Carabao Cup fourth round |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/liverpool-face-chelsea-carabao-cup-fourth-round |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |date=16 September 2026}}</ref>

===UEFA Champions League===
{{main|2026–27 UEFA Champions League}}

As the fifth-placed team in the [[2025–26 Premier League]], Liverpool entered the UEFA Champions League in the league phase.

====League phase====
{{main|2026–27 UEFA Champions League league phase}}

The league phase draw was held on 27 August 2026. Liverpool were drawn at home against [[Atlético Madrid]], [[FC Porto|Porto]], [[Villarreal CF|Villarreal]], [[RC Lens|Lens]], and away to [[Inter Milan]], [[Club Brugge KV|Club Brugge]], [[Fenerbahçe S.K. (football)|Fenerbahçe]] and [[LASK]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Champions League league phase draw: All 36 teams learn their opponents |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/02a8-216cd740d41f-fd3b45ac4a0f-1000 |publisher=UEFA |date=27 August 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Liverpool discover Champions League league-phase opponents |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/liverpool-discover-champions-league-league-phase-opponents |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |date=27 August 2026}}</ref>
